title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_ctx.c:527 Type mismatch between header and implementation: oscore_ctx_get_sender_seq() and oscore_ctx_get_seq_remaining() write 4 bytes (uint32_t) to caller's 8-byte (uint64_t*) buffer. On little-endian, upper 4 bytes are left uninitialized; on big-endian, wrong 4 bytes are written. Causes undefined behavior and incorrect sequence number reads.
